theme.about: boosty (cyan ring on black), dark or light. Rows, tiles and the sidebar inside inherit it; any --tk-tv-* property overrides one value.

label.about: The screen's accessible name (a labelled region).

input.about: What drives focus: "keys" (arrow keys, Enter, Backspace, Escape, while focus is inside), "pad" (a gamepad), "keys pad", or "none".

capture.about: Also read keys while focus is in a text field (ignored by default).

guides.about: Draw the action-safe, title-safe and safe-area guides (a development aid).

screen.about: Hold a 16:9 frame with the rows scrolling inside it, as a screen does (auto height below 600px wide).

calm.about: No motion at all, whatever the OS says: no lift, no fades, no smooth scrolling.

onVerb.about: Every verb the remote sends ({ verb, dir, source, code }).

onSelect.about: A tile was chosen (click, Enter, A or the remote's select).

onExit.about: Back with nowhere left to go back to: the host decides (close, confirm, ignore).

children.about: A <TvSidebar> (it takes the menu slot by itself), rows, and anything with slot="overlay".
